mapper.select: SELECT refresh_token_id,employee_id,token_hash,issued_at,expires_at,revoked_at,replaced_by_token_id,device_info,client_ip FROM refresh_token WHERE token_hash=#{tokenHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at>#{now} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE refresh_token SET revoked_at=#{now},replaced_by_token_id=#{replacementId} WHERE refresh_token_id=#{tokenId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE refresh_token SET revoked_at=#{now} WHERE token_hash=#{tokenHash} AND employee_id=#{employeeId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE refresh_token SET revoked_at=#{now} WHERE employee_id=#{employeeId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
